content.text:
The site's custom font had stopped loading, so every page was showing the browser's fallback system font. That's why all of them looked different at once.

**Cause:** in `site/css/tokens.css:5`, the `@font-face` rule pointed to `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the folder is actually `site/fonts/`. The font request failed and every page fell back to `system-ui`. That changed the letter shapes and widths throughout and made text wrap differently, so some pages got taller. The phone About page, for example, was 27px taller than the approved screenshot.

**Fix:** I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. I also checked every other local link to CSS, JS, images and pages, and they all point to files that exist.

**Result:** all 28 tests pass: the 12 visual comparisons (six pages at desktop and phone size) and the 16 functional tests.

The repo has only one commit, so there was no earlier version to compare against, and the broken path is already in that commit. The fix is uncommitted in your working tree; tell me if you'd like me to commit it.

STATUS: DONE
